english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone or something that is creative, especially in an original or imaginative way.
This is the all-purpose choice for an inventive person or an original idea or reply.
Use this when original means inventive, imaginative, or different from ordinary ideas.

examples.english: This ad's concept is really creative.
examples.traditional: 呢個廣告個橋段真係好有創意。

examples.english: This designer is really ingenious and always comes up with new ideas.
examples.traditional: 呢個設計師真係好有創意，成日諗到啲新橋。

examples.english: Your idea is really original—you turned old things into something so nice.
examples.traditional: 你個諗法真係有創意，將舊物變到咁靚。
